name: context
description: 上下文工具（action 分派）。action=compact：AI 自主压缩当前对话的上下文（把较早的消息折叠为结构化摘要，缓解上下文占用；运行中也可用）。action=search：检索历史上下文（BM25 智能检索）——scope=current 检索本对话当前上下文，scope=all 跨全部会话检索；可查证此前读过/讨论过的内容。注意：压缩会物理移除被折叠消息，摘要中未记录的内容无法再检索到。
description_en: Context tool (dispatched by action). action=compact: the AI proactively compacts the current conversation context (folds earlier messages into a structured summary to relieve context pressure; usable while running). action=search: retrieves historical context (BM25 smart search) — scope=current searches this conversation's current context, scope=all searches across all sessions; useful to recover previously read/discussed content. Note: compaction physically removes folded messages; content not captured in the summary is no longer searchable.

focus.description: compact：压缩时的附加焦点（优先保留的内容，可选）
focus.description_en: compact: additional focus to preserve when compacting (optional)

query.description: search：检索查询（自然语言关键词）

scope.description: search：检索范围。current=本对话当前上下文（默认）；all=跨全部会话
scope.description_en: search: scope. current=this conversation's current context (default); all=all sessions

includeCompacted.description: search：兼容字段（当前压缩物理移除原文，已折叠内容不可检索；保留字段避免旧调用报错）
includeCompacted.description_en: search: compatibility field (compaction physically removes originals; folded content is not searchable)

includeTool.description: search：是否包含工具结果消息（默认 false，噪声较大）
includeTool.description_en: search: include tool-result messages (default false, noisier)

topK.description: search：返回条数上限（默认 10，最大 50）
